positive.text: Prohibition rested on U.S. Const. amend. XVIII (repealed 1933) for a time.
Compare U.S. Const. art. I, § 9, cl. 4 (superseded 1913) with the Sixteenth Amendment.

negative: The Eighteenth Amendment was repealed in 1933.
Article XVIII (repealed 1933) of the club bylaws is gone.

note: R23.1 example `U.S. Const. amend. XVIII (repealed 1933)`: the status parenthetical is part of the cite, so this rule outranks us.fed.constitution (60) and spans it.
